name: @nuxt/a11y
description: Nuxt module to provide accessibility hinting and utilities.

scripts.build: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxt-module-build build && pnpm run client:build
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxt prepare client && nuxt prepare playground && pnpm --dir playground-v5 exec nuxt prepare && pnpm --dir test/fixtures/nuxt-v5 exec nuxt prepare
scripts.play:prod: pnpm run build && nuxt dev playground
scripts.release: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run prepack && changelogen --release && pnpm publish && git push --follow-tags
scripts.test:types: vue-tsc --noEmit && cd playground && vue-tsc -b --noEmit && cd ../client && vue-tsc -b --noEmit
